description: Builds an interlocking crossword grid with standard numbering. Words come from --words "WORD: clue; WORD2: clue2", --file (JSON [{word,clue}] or "WORD: clue" lines), or --theme (clues are auto-generated puzzle-style hints). Words that cannot interlock are reported as unplaced. Deterministic with --seed. Online version: https://puzzletide.com/crossword

count.description: Number of words to use from the theme/file (default: 10)

file.description: JSON array of {word, clue} or "WORD: clue" lines

paper.description: PDF paper size: letter or a4 (default: letter)

pdf.description: Also write a printable PDF worksheet to <file>

seed.description: Seed for reproducible output (number or word)

solution.description: Print the solution instead of the puzzle

solutionPage.description: Omit the solution page from PDF output — set false to disable

svg.description: Also write an SVG image to <file>

theme.description: Use a bundled word bank theme (auto-generated clues)

name: puzzle_crossword_generate
title: crossword generate
